description: - Push exercises involve exerting force away from the body or pushing an object away from oneself during the concentric contraction of the target muscle. - The primary muscle groups targeted in push exercises are the muscles on the front side of the body, including the chest, shoulders, and triceps. - Examples of push exercises include push-ups, bench press, shoulder press, and triceps dips. - Push exercises often involve extension or pushing movements at joints such as the shoulder, elbow, or hip.
name: Push

description: - Pull exercises involve exerting force towards the body or pulling an object towards oneself during the concentric contraction of the target muscle. - The primary muscle groups targeted in pull exercises are the muscles on the back side of the body, including the back muscles, biceps, and forearms. - Examples of pull exercises include pull-ups, rows, lat pulldowns, and bicep curls. - Pull exercises often involve flexion or pulling movements at joints such as the shoulder, elbow, or hip.
name: Pull
